svg.aria-label: Floor framing and soil support: feasibility unresolved
svg.text: FLOOR AND GROUND SUPPORT / FEASIBILITY UNVERIFIED
Requested: direct placement on soil; pads, ballast and anchors are restricted.
118 numbered members cover UPPER STRUCTURE ONLY; floor framing is excluded.
7200 x 6000 EXTERIOR ENVELOPE - PLAN NOT TO SCALE
FLOOR DECK, JOISTS AND BOTTOM BEAMS: NOT DESIGNED
SUPPORT / SOIL CONTACT LOCATIONS AND AREAS: UNRESOLVED
COLUMN-TO-BASE LOAD TRANSFER / UPLIFT RESTRAINT: UNRESOLVED
SITE CHECKS: bearing, settlement, wind uplift, sliding and overturning.
Maximum roof height remains 2800 above outdoor ground.
Raised floor and roof build-up consume this height; interior clear height TBD.
FINAL PIPE SECTIONS AND CUT LENGTHS ON HOLD PENDING COMPLETE DESIGN.
